info.title: Nizam API — Customer
info.description:
The **Nizam Customer Portal API** is the surface for end buyers — the people who place orders inside a Nizam-powered marketplace. Use this API to manage your profile, view your orders, and track deliveries.

This is one of the [audience-scoped Nizam APIs](https://docs.nizam.ai/api/overview). It shares the wire-level conventions (RFC 9457 errors, cursor pagination) with every other Nizam audience — see the [API conventions reference](https://docs.nizam.ai/api/conventions) for the canonical description. This page covers what's specific to the Customer Portal.

## Audience

This API ships in the **Customer SDK** (`@nizam-os/customer-sdk` on npm). Consumers are individual end buyers using a self-service portal — typically embedded in a merchant's storefront or a Nizam-branded buyer experience.

Tenant-side concerns (organizations, fleet, dispatch) and merchant-side concerns (catalog, fulfillment) are on their respective SDKs and never appear in this surface.

## Authentication

Issued by the **`nizam-customer-portal`** Keycloak client. Authorization Code + PKCE flow.

Every JWT carries:

| Claim | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `azp` | `nizam-customer-portal` — identifies this Portal at the server. |
| `sub` | The customer's UUID. |
| `organization` | The Organization whose marketplace the customer belongs to. May be omitted for cross-tenant customer flows. |
| `resource_access.nizam-customer-portal.roles` | Always contains `customer`. |

## Roles

Single role: `customer`. No further differentiation. Authorization is implicit — every endpoint in this SDK accepts any authenticated customer.

## Surface

The smallest of the Nizam surfaces:

- `/v1/me` — your profile.
- `/v1/lookups/*` — countries, currencies, languages, timezones.
- Customer-specific surface (orders, tracking, addresses) lands as Nizam's commerce surface comes online.

## Privacy

Customer data is scoped to the individual buyer via Postgres Row-Level Security on the `customer_id` session variable. You can only read and modify rows tied to your own `sub` claim — RLS prevents reading another customer's profile or orders even if you forge their id in a path. The platform staff console exists for support actions that legitimately need cross-customer visibility; those actions are audited.

## Status

This SDK is intentionally narrow today. Customer-facing features land alongside the commerce subsystem.

get.description:
Returns the authenticated user merged with profile claims from their JWT.

JIT-provisions a shadow row on the first call (so a brand-new Keycloak user can hit any
endpoint without an explicit signup step) and stamps `last_login_at` + increments
`login_count` on every subsequent call.

The `roles` array combines realm roles (flat, e.g. `platform_admin`) with portal-scoped
client roles (prefixed, e.g. `dashboard:dispatcher`). The frontend usually drops the
portal prefix when rendering since it knows its own portal.

ProblemDetail.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details for HTTP APIs, with Nizam extensions for `code`, `trace_id`, and `errors`.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: URI reference for the specific occurrence (typically the request path).

code.description: Machine-readable identifier. Stable across releases. Snake_case; resource-prefixed for domain errors (e.g., `user.email_already_taken`).

trace_id.description: OpenTelemetry trace id from the request — match to logs for support.

errors.description: Per-field validation errors. Populated only when status=422.

ApiFieldError.description: One field-level entry inside a 422 validation problem.

field.description: Dot-notated JSON path matching the request shape.

slug.description: Optional URL-safe slug. When omitted, the server derives one from the name.

primary_domain.description: Optional primary email domain. When set, Keycloak attaches it to the new Organization so per-domain IdP discovery works.

business_category.description: Optional self-selected vertical from /v1/lookups/business-categories. Lowercase slug (e.g. 'restaurant', 'third_party_logistics'). Drives downstream personalization.

phone.description: Optional contact phone number in E.164 format (leading +, country code, then digits).

Organization.description: A tenant — a logistics company, 3PL, or LSP.

id.description: Stable UUID. Equal to the Keycloak Organization id.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier — used in deep links and admin tooling.

founder_user_id.description: User id of the human who originally created this organization. Immutable for the row's lifetime — does NOT change when ownership is transferred.

owner_user_id.description: User id of the current owner. Receives all admin notifications by default. Mutable; reassigned via ownership transfer. May be null transiently if the owner user has been hard-deleted.

responsible_party.description: Legal entity accountable for this operator's actions (a user id).

user_id.description: Linked user id (when the human has a Nizam login).

CreateOperatorRequest.description: Create a new operator. The kind discriminator selects the variant.

controller_user_id.description: User id of the human controller at the remote console.

Operator.description: A controlling agent — human, autonomous software, teleoperator, or hybrid.

user_id.description: Linked user id (humans with a Nizam login). Null for software agents.

responsible_party_id.description: Legal entity accountable for this operator (required for autonomous/teleoperated).

role.description: Role the recipient will hold after acceptance. Lowercase enum names from MembershipRole.

organization_id.description: Organization the invite confers membership in.

role.description: Role the recipient will hold after acceptance.

expires_at.description: When the invite expires. Recipients must accept before then.

token.description: Bearer secret used to redeem the invite. Returned only on POST /v1/invites; subsequent lookups omit it.

Assignment.description: Time-bound binding between an asset and an operator in a role.

role.description: Role discriminator for concurrent assignments on the same asset.

terminated_reason.description: Why the assignment was closed (null while active).

reason.description: Why the assignment is being closed.

Asset.description: A physical asset tracked by the fleet — vehicle, drone, robot, container, etc.

name.description: New display name. Omit to leave unchanged.

slug.description: New URL-safe slug. Cross-tenant unique. Cascades to the Keycloak Organization's alias. Omit to leave unchanged.

business_category.description: New business category — lowercase slug from /v1/lookups/business-categories. Omit to leave unchanged.

phone.description: New contact phone in E.164 format. Omit to leave unchanged.

country.description: New ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Omit to leave unchanged.

timezone.description: New IANA timezone identifier. Omit to leave unchanged.

object.description: Object type discriminator (Stripe pattern). Always `list` for this envelope.

has_previous.description: True when earlier pages exist; pass `prev_cursor` as `?ending_before=` to fetch the previous page.
